title: Private Deployments: Transition Plan, Release Notes Workflow, and Enablement Cadence for RBAC/Audit/KMS
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Goal: Coordinate a clear transition and go-to-market routine for Private/VPC/on-prem features covering RBAC, Audit Logs, and KMS integration. Deliverables: 1) a runbook for release notes and comms tailored to enterprise buyers; 2) enablement kit (playbooks, training slides, short video demos); 3) cross-team readiness checklist (Eng, Design, Sales, Support, Security); 4) staged rollout plan and rollback triggers; 5) telemetry and post-launch evaluation criteria. Scope: features already in engineering backlog (RBAC v1, audit event export, KMS key rotation support) and their enterprise-facing documentation and enablement materials. Out of scope: major UX redesign for Admin console (tracked separately), deep legal contract language (handled by Legal).
acceptance_criteria: Release notes published in standard format and syndicated to docs, support KB, and sales playbook
Enablement kit uploaded to Drive and a recording scheduled for partner/customer onboarding sessions
Cross-team readiness checklist completed with named owners and no open P0 issues 5 business days before GA
Telemetry dashboards show key signals (adoption by private deployments, activation of RBAC, KMS key attachments) within 2 weeks of GA
Rollback and mitigation steps documented and validated in staging
rollout_plan: Week -4: Feature freeze for release notes content; marketing drafts announcement copy; security signs off on KMS docs
Week -3: Internal enablement (sales/solutions) — 60m live walk-through + Q&A; post recording to Drive
Week -2: Beta cohort (3 pilot customers) enabled via feature flag; collect feedback; triage critical issues
Week -1: Lock release notes and KB articles; publish staged docs to private preview site; support runbook dry-run
GA day: Toggle public availability for Hosted and schedule Dedicated/Private deployments via customer onboarding calendar
Post-GA Week 1: Daily check-ins for P0/P1 tickets; telemetry triage and quick fixes; publish first-week FAQ
Post-GA Week 4: Retrospective, adoption metric review, and decision on any follow-up UX or API improvements

Pilot customers experience audit export failures at scale — mitigation: throttling and retry strategy in place; support playbook prepared
Legal/Compliance requests for contract language may delay enterprise comms — mitigation: publish technical release notes first and follow with legal-approved contract addendum
